camera: Three-quarter top-down view (SNES-era Zelda: A Link to the Past style) — subject viewed from a raised angle, facing forward/downward toward the viewer, centered and filling most of the frame.
style: AUTHENTIC LOW-RESOLUTION SPRITE, not a painted illustration and not a graph-paper mockup. Render exactly as if it were a real 32x32-tile SNES game sprite (Link to the Past / Pokemon Gen 3 overworld scale) saved and then scaled up with nearest-neighbor (blocky, NOT smoothed): each pixel is one big flat square of solid color, filling large chunky rectangular blocks. CRITICAL — DO NOT draw any visible grid lines, graph-paper lines, ruled lines, or a checkerboard/lattice pattern anywhere in the image, including the empty background — adjacent same-color pixels must merge into one solid flat rectangle with NO line or seam drawn between them; the only lines allowed are the bold ~1-pixel-thick BLACK outline around the character's silhouette and its major internal shape breaks (jacket vs fur vs boots), nothing else. CRITICAL #2 — DO NOT render any fine crosshatch, weave, canvas-grain, stipple, speckle, or graph-paper TEXTURE inside any single color block, even a subtle one — zoom into any one color band and it must be 100% one uniform flat RGB value with zero internal variation, not a mottled/noisy/textured fill; this is the single most common failure mode, treat it as an instant reject. STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: smooth gradients, soft airbrushed shading, blur, anti-aliasing, dithering, noise, grain, painterly brushwork, photographic texture, soft drop shadows, any grid/graph overlay. Shading is done ONLY by stepping between 2-3 flat color bands per surface (light band / base band / dark band), each a hard-edged rectangle, never a blend. Very limited palette: no more than ~16 flat colors total. Strong, simple, iconic silhouette that reads instantly at thumbnail size.
palette: Punk-rock accents — black leather, studded silver, and a loud mohawk/highlight color (hot pink, acid green, or electric blue) — set against warm overworld earth tones (mossy greens, browns, weathered wood and stone). Exact colors vary per asset, specified in the asset description.
background: 100% fully transparent background (alpha = 0), completely empty outside the character's silhouette — no scene, no shadow, no grid lines, no noise, no faint color cast, no other objects. Only the character's own opaque pixels should have any alpha at all.
constraints: Square 1:1 composition. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no drop shadow outside the subject, no gradients anywhere, no grid or graph-paper lines anywhere in the image.
mainCharacter: Beverly, a stocky punk-rock dog (NOT a bear, NOT a wolf — a dog: rounded floppy ears, a dog snout with a small black nose-tip, NOT a pointed fox/wolf snout). LOCKED exact palette, identical in every single image of her, every pose, every direction, no exceptions: fur light band #d9a15c, fur base band #c98a4b, fur dark band #96602f, fur outline/shadow #5a3a1e; mohawk light band #ff6fc2, mohawk base band #ff3fa0, mohawk dark band #a8236c; leather jacket light band #3a3a3a, jacket base band #1b1b1b, jacket dark band #0a0a0a; jacket studs flat #c9cdd2; pants light band #3f8f72, pants base band #2f6d57, pants dark band #1e4a3a; boots light band #a8703c, boots base band #7a4f27, boots dark band #4a2f16; eyes flat black #1b1b1b with a small flat white #f4f0e6 highlight square; dagger blade flat #d7dde0 with dark #8a9096 edge line, dagger handle #5a4632. Same round head-to-body proportions, same jacket silhouette, same mohawk height/shape, same stance width in every frame — only the pose (standing / mid-stride / mid-swing) and camera-facing direction change between images, never the colors or proportions.
enemy: Junk Rat, a scrappy quadruped mutant rat welded together with scavenged junkyard parts. LOCKED exact palette, identical in every image, every pose: body fur light band #c0863a, body base band #996621, body dark band #6c3f14, outline/shadow near-black #201a16; mohawk-style tuft of mossy spiked fur on the head, light #7fae3f, dark #3a6c22; one small gray/silver scavenged armor-plate patch bolted on a shoulder, flat #b9bec2 with dark #6b7075 edge; a long segmented tail in dull red/rust, light #c0524a, dark #8a2f28; a small flat yellow-gold eye/marking dot #e0b23a; teeth flat white #f4f0e6; whiskers thin white lines. Same low, long-bodied quadruped proportions and same head/tail shape in every frame — only the pose (standing / mid-stride / mid-pounce) and camera-facing direction change between images, never the colors or proportions.
